learner.description: Lossless ReLU lift (input kept as channel 0 + 31 learned channels), 4 additive coupling blocks on 16+16 channels (alpha 0.25), dense 2592-128-10 head; backward reconstructs block inputs
learner.training_randomness: Held fixed across draws: member seeds 11, 22, 33 set initialization and augmentation/shuffle schedules
learner.recipe: 8 epochs, batch 128, SGD lr 0.03 momentum 0.9 weight decay 1e-4, mild affine augmentation, ordered FP32 Triton kernels (no FMA, FTZ or tensor cores)
learner.ensemble: Ordered FP32 sum of the three members' logits, then first-index argmax
learner.selection_history: Architecture and recipe chosen on 13 Sep 2026 from exploratory sweeps on other draws of the same 60,000-image pool; see history/

evaluation: All eleven prediction files are saved and hashed in prediction-freeze.json before any test label is read; then mnist.code.evaluate --tier medium --error-target 3 scores each draw and the pass uses sum(correct)/110000.
divergence_policy: A non-finite member ends that draw as a recorded failure; no rerun with other seeds. Eleven completed draws are required.

a100.energy: Paired-idle NVML (nvml_energy.py, copied unchanged from rev88-20260914/energy.py) on draw 00, three trials
a100.control: Matched non-reversible CNN ensemble measured the same way
